limits.note: name and description are the two required fields
lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only
name and description are the two required fields; description must be non-empty

Anthropic: 'under 500 lines', so a body of this many lines or more is reported. The page names no token limit. Shipwright's own, stricter runtime-prompt size limit and its anti-ratchet baseline are enforced elsewhere (see shared/prompts/writing-plugin.md) and not repeated here
every reference file is linked from SKILL.md; a reference that links on to another reference file makes Claude preview it with head and read it incompletely

a reference file longer than this starts with a table of contents; 'starts with' is read as: within the first 'window' lines (a heading named Contents, or an in-page anchor link). The window is a judgement call, small enough that a partial read (head -100) still sees it
judgement, not countable: a description says what the skill does and when to use it, in third person. Reviewed by a person or the AI.
